# Output.ai

Skills and agents that teach agents to work with Output.ai. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [growthxai/output](https://github.com/growthxai/output), at commit `2032ff6`.

Workflow development tools

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Output.ai**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Output.ai**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install outputai@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

51 skills: `output-build-workflow`, `output-credentials-edit`, `output-credentials-env-vars`, `output-credentials-init`, `output-debug-workflow`, `output-dev-agent-class`, `output-dev-code-style`, `output-dev-cost-hooks`, `output-dev-create-skeleton`, `output-dev-credentials`, `output-dev-eval-testing`, `output-dev-evaluator-function`, `output-dev-folder-structure`, `output-dev-http-client-create`, `output-dev-llm-streaming`, `output-dev-model-selection`, `output-dev-prompt-file`, `output-dev-scenario-file`, `output-dev-skill-file`, `output-dev-step-function`, `output-dev-types-file`, `output-dev-upgrade-prompt-models`, `output-dev-workflow-cost`, `output-dev-workflow-function`, `output-error-direct-io`, `output-error-http-client`, `output-error-missing-schemas`, `output-error-nondeterminism`, `output-error-try-catch`, `output-error-zod-import`, `output-eval-audit`, `output-eval-dataset-design`, `output-eval-error-analysis`, `output-eval-judge-prompt`, `output-eval-validate-judge`, `output-meta-post-flight`, `output-meta-pre-flight`, `output-meta-project-context`, `output-migrate`, `output-plan-workflow`, and 11 more.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SERVICE_API_KEY`, `JINA_API_KEY`. This plugin does not store them.
